components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 40px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font: 600 14px/1.25 var(--font-inter), system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 25%, transparent); transition: transform 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out, background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 90%, black); box-shadow: 0 8px 12px color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 35%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 45%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(.97); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { height: 40px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--background) 90%, transparent); color: var(--foreground); font: 600 14px/1.25 var(--font-inter), system-ui, sans-serif; transition: transform 150ms ease-out, background-color 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--muted); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 45%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: scale(.97); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: The default search and form field.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 280px; height: 40px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--border) 70%, transparent); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--muted); color: var(--foreground); font: 400 14px/1.5 var(--font-inter), system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / .18); transition: border-color 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--border); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ring); outline: 3px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 45%, transparent); outline-offset: 0; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: A compact semantic or selected-state label.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 20px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font: 600 12px/1.35 var(--font-inter), system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 25%, transparent); }

components.name: Work Card
components.html:
Functional Requirement

Review scope, priority, and current version status.
components.css: .ds-card { width: 320px; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--border) 80%, transparent); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--card); color: var(--card-foreground); box-shadow: 0 4px 6px color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 12%, transparent); font-family: var(--font-inter), system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 200ms ease-out, background-color 200ms ease-out; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: var(--border); background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--card) 92%, white); } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0 0 6px; font: 500 16px/1.35 var(--font-roboto-condensed), var(--font-inter), sans-serif; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted-foreground); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Sidebar Navigation Item
components.description: A compact active destination in the project sidebar.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 36px; padding: 8px 10px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 30%, transparent); border-radius: 8px; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 10%, transparent); color: var(--foreground); font: 500 14px/1.35 var(--font-inter), system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 200ms ease-out, border-color 200ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 14%, transparent); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 45%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
The interface is a focused workspace for turning ambiguous project input into reviewable, traceable artifacts. Its dark neutral foundation lowers visual fatigue, while jade and mint provide a precise signal for action, selection, and progress.

The system is information-dense but never frantic. Familiar controls, stable navigation, restrained motion, and clear state language create trust. It explicitly rejects playful consumer-app styling, generic neon AI cockpit visuals, decorative glassmorphism, gradient-heavy surfaces, ornamental SaaS dashboards, and interactions that trade clarity for novelty.
keyCharacteristics: Dark neutral work surfaces with a restrained jade signal color.
Compact, repeatable controls designed for long working sessions.
Clear hierarchy across organization, project, artifact, and AI-assistant contexts.
State-driven motion that remains useful with reduced motion enabled.
Human review and next actions are visible whenever AI participates.

rules.name: The Signal Color Rule
rules.body: Jade and mint communicate action, selection, progress, or status. They are never scattered as decoration.

rules.name: The Neutral Canvas Rule
rules.body: The application canvas stays neutral charcoal. Brand abyss is an overlay and brand depth token, not a full-page background.

rules.name: The One Working Voice Rule
rules.body: Inter is the default interface voice. Roboto Condensed and Rubik earn their use through hierarchy or brand function; they never appear merely to add variety.

rules.name: The Flat-Until-Active Rule
rules.body: Tonal contrast and borders establish structure at rest. Strong shadows appear only when interaction or layer hierarchy requires them.

rules.name: The One Boundary Rule
rules.body: Do not combine a decorative wide shadow with a decorative border. Each boundary must have a structural reason.

rules.name: The Familiar Control Rule
rules.body: A save button, filter, select, dialog, or table behaves like the same control everywhere else in the product.

dos: Do use neutral charcoal surfaces as the dominant canvas and reserve Working Jade for meaningful state.
Do keep controls compact, keyboard accessible, and visually consistent across organizations, projects, artifacts, and AI panels.
Do use 150–250ms state transitions with clear reduced-motion alternatives.
Do show loading, empty, error, approval, and uncertainty states with an obvious next action.
Do preserve readable contrast and non-color cues for every semantic state.
donts: Don't use playful consumer-app styling that makes professional project work feel lightweight.
Don't use generic neon AI cockpit visuals, excessive glow, or technology theater.
Don't use decorative glassmorphism, gradient-heavy surfaces, or ornamental SaaS dashboards.
Don't introduce inconsistent controls or novel interactions that make standard tasks harder to learn.
Don't ship empty states or AI output that hide uncertainty or leave the next action unclear.
Don't use colored side-stripe borders, gradient text, oversized card radii, or decorative motion.
